newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay harvests 2.5 million tonnes of soybeans.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay harvests 2.5 million tonnes of soybeans.

text.p: Paraguay's 1996/97 soybean harvest has ended with production of about 2.5 million tonnes, Paraguayan Cereals and Oilseeds Chamber said Wednesday.
Sales abroad should total 1.8 million tonnes, of which 720,000 tonnes had already been exported by April, the chamber's technical manager, Luis Cubilla, told Reuters.
"We had an excellent harvest," Cubilla said, "We obtained healthy and very clean beans."
The crop suffered slightly from too much rain in January and February, which made weed control more difficult.
"This problem did cause a drop in harvest volume, but fortunately not a big drop," Cubilla said.
Output from this year's sown area of 1.0 million hectares was slightly higher than last season's 2.4 million tonnes, harvested from 960,000 hectares.
